Convert salaries to USD

convert_currency_to_usd.Rd

Convert local salary amounts to US dollars (USD). This function takes into account the variation of exchange rates by work year (work_year).

Usage

convert_currency_to_usd(data)

Arguments

data

A data.frame that must contain at least the following columns:

  • salary: The gross amount in the local currency.

  • salary_currency: The ISO code of the currency (e.g. "EUR", "GBP").

  • work_year: The reference fiscal year.

  • salary_in_usd: (Optional, will be overwritten/created).

Value

The data.frame enriched with the computed salary_in_usd column.

Details

The conversion procedure is as follows:

  1. Validation: Checks that the columns salary, salary_currency and work_year are present.

  2. Typing: Ensures that the salary is numeric and the year is an integer.

  3. Join: Merges the data with the reference table exchange_rates_to_usd based on currency and year.

  4. Computation: Applies the exchange rate to update salary_in_usd.

  5. Cleanup: Removes temporary rate columns (rate).

Note

This function depends on the global object exchange_rates_to_usd, which must contain the columns currency, year and rate.

Examples

# For the example to work, we simulate the exchange rate table
# Normally, this object 'exchange_rates_to_usd' is loaded in the package
exchange_rates_to_usd <- data.frame(
  currency = c("EUR", "GBP"),
  year = c(2023, 2023),
  rate = c(1.1, 1.25) # 1 EUR = 1.1 USD
)

df <-  data.frame(
  salary = 60000,
  salary_currency = "GBP",
  salary_in_usd = 75000,
  work_year = 2023
)

# Conversion
convert_currency_to_usd(df)
#> Error in convert_currency_to_usd(df): could not find function "convert_currency_to_usd"
